topics.title: Recall: distance, section formula and area of a triangle

concepts.learning_objective: Apply the distance, section and mid-point formulae to points in the coordinate plane.
Use the area of a triangle in coordinates to find areas and test collinearity.
Relate the inclination of a line to its slope m = tan(theta).
Find the slope of a line through two given points.
Use slopes to decide whether two lines are parallel or perpendicular.
Test three points for collinearity using slopes.
Find the angle between two lines from their slopes using tan(theta) = |(m2 - m1)/(1 + m1m2)|.

topics.title: Horizontal, vertical, point-slope and two-point forms

concepts.learning_objective: Write equations of lines parallel to the coordinate axes.
Write the equation of a line through a point with a given slope.
Write the equation of a line through two given points.
Express a line as y = mx + c and read its slope and y-intercept.
Use x/a + y/b = 1 to write and interpret lines from their intercepts.
Convert the general equation Ax + By + C = 0 into other forms.

topics.title: Distance of a point from a line and between parallel lines

concepts.learning_objective: Find the perpendicular distance of a point from a line.
Find the distance between two parallel lines.
